references.text: The land became defiled because of sin, and God punished it for its wrongdoings—the same theme that sin makes the land unclean.
God promises to have his dwelling among the children of Israel and walk among them—God's presence in the midst of his people.
God commands that they build a sanctuary so he can dwell among them—God's dwelling place among Israel.
God declares that he will dwell among the children of Israel and be their God—God's presence and identity as LORD.
God will dwell among the children of Israel forever, and they shall no longer defile his holy name—God's dwelling and purity in the land.
Israel made the land unclean with their conduct and deeds, like a woman's uncleanness—the land's defilement due to bloodguilt.
They shed innocent blood and profaned the land with bloodguilt—bloodguilt makes the land unclean.
God's dwelling shall be among humanity, and he will dwell among them—the fulfillment of God's promise to dwell in the midst of his people.
Believers are the temple of the living God, and God will dwell among them—God's presence among his people in the new covenant.
